prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original One Ring setting illustration of BREE'S MARKETPLACE, where Men and hobbits live together. Match the user's approved light-ivory pencil scene series, but change the camera to a LOW, NEAR-GROUND street-level viewpoint, roughly knee height to an adult human, looking along wet-worn cobblestones into the market square. Strong foreground perspective: large carefully sketched cobbles, a shallow gutter and the base of a produce basket lead toward the stalls and clustered buildings. Bree is a welcoming lived-in early medieval town: timber-and-plaster houses with steep roofs, stone lower walls, chimneys, crooked upper storeys and climbing plants; the wooded slope of Bree-hill rises behind the rooftops. Alongside the human-sized shops, clearly show HOMES AND SHOPS ADAPTED FOR HOBBITS: small round-topped or round doors low in the walls, low windows, short little steps, a low bench and a small produce stall or counter scaled for hobbit customers. These should be integrated into a mixed town, not an entire Shire-style hillside of hobbit holes. Taller human doorways and normal-height stalls nearby make the size differences immediately legible. Market stalls sell vegetables, apples, mushrooms, baskets, cloth and bread; crates and barrels, canvas awnings, hanging simple unlettered shop signs. A handful of SMALL MIDGROUND TOWNSFOLK show everyday market life: two adult hobbits with curly hair, practical waistcoats and bare broad feet near a low produce counter, and two or three human traders or shoppers near normal-sized stalls. These figures establish the mixed community, but no close-up portrait, dominant foreground person, giant feet or crowded action. Low camera should reveal the awnings and steep roofs overhead while preserving a readable open view down the marketplace. Friendly grounded rural trading town, calm ordinary daylight, no grand castle, elven architecture or modern objects. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil drawing on very light near-white warm ivory paper, subtle paper grain, expressive fine contours, restrained parallel hatching and crosshatching, airy shading and plenty of untouched paper. Nearby cobbles, small doors, baskets and stalls selectively detailed, farther shops and hill lighter and simpler. Match the approved series' pale paper, no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. No colored paint, thick brushwork, watercolor wash, heavy black ink fills, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed composition, intended final export 2560x1440. No lettering, readable signs, labels, captions, map symbols, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
